/ -> /copy -> /edit -> /fork -> /help -> /new -> /open
/c -> /copy
/copy  -> /copy session-dir -> /copy session-id -> /copy session-name
/edit  -> /edit config-dir -> /edit config-file -> /edit home-dir
/open  -> /open config-dir -> /open config-file -> /open home-dir -> /open scratch-dir -> /open session-chat -> /open session-dir -> /open session-log -> /open skills-dir -> /open system-prompt -> /open workspace-dir
